Harrison's life is threatened when he tries to save a brother and sister whose panicked state leads them to start drowning their rescuer.

Big swell and powerful rips at Bondi's south corner. Lifeguard Yatesy attempts the rescue of an inexperienced surfer in 10-foot swell. Meanwhile, increased shark sightings prompt the lifeguards to test new deterrent technology for the future safety of Bondi swimmers and lifeguards.

Russian body builder Dimitri breaks both legs after he plunges down the cliff at North Bondi. A learner paddleboarder snaps her collar bone in the shore break. And Chappo's rescue skills in the South Corner earn him the title 'Chappo's Corner'. But one veteran lifeguard is having none of it.

During storm season, a tornado hits Southern Sydney. Tourists brave the waves at Bondi. Jesse, alone in the tower, can't assist a drowning man as all lifeguards are busy in the water. Two thrill-seekers encounter trouble in the big swell, and a British rapper embraces the storm to feel the music.

62-year-old lifeguard Harry faces the risk of losing his job as he competes against younger colleagues in a fitness test, thieves face a violent citizens arrest and lifeguards are startled by the frantic search of a mother calling for her daughter, Jennifer.

Lifeguards lay down the law after a woman reports being spat on at Bondi Beach. New lifeguard Will attends a medical emergency involving an unconscious teenager. In the midst of a howling gale, a woman brings a fleet of giant inflatables to Bondi. Local larrikin Harries helps tame the wild toys.

Hundreds of Dutch tourists hit Bondi for a New Years swim - straight in to Backpackers Rip. A diabetic comes to the tower with low blood sugar, and then suffers an epileptic fit. Troy uses the Lifeguard security camera to identify a group of bag thieves operating on Bondi.

Three girls report a flasher, prompting lifeguard investigation. Will and Bagus continuously perform rescues at the south end, relocating everyone away from dangerous flash rips. A disobedient swimmer needs rescue. Jethro and Chase test a homemade surfboard throne.

A Swedish tourist comes off second best while showing off his backflipping skills. After a girl is rushed to the tower suffering an anaphylactic shock, Jackson must administer the EpiPen. Lifeguards reap the rewards after Chase and Max land two huge fish onto their jetskis.

Lifeguards conduct an experiment with dangerous current signs, attaching stickers offering cash rewards for those who read the signs. After 4 days no one has collected any money, and lifeguards rescue a whole family directly in front of the signs.

Dr. Kim chooses the extreme method to save Minister Ryu. After Dr. Kim manages to bring Minister Ryu back to life, Min Kook starts doubting Dr. Kim's real intention and skills. After Min Kook announces the Minister's condition to the press, Dr. Kim just doesn't seem to care. Eun Jae asks Woo Jin to attend the second surgery, but he refuses.

Min Kook asks Woo Jin questions about the primary surgery that Dr. Kim operated on, and Woo Jin hesitates to answer them. The director of Doldam Hospital comes back to the hospital, and Ah Reum greets him. Eun Jae gets furious at Woo Jin for taking away her opportunity to be in the second operation with Min Kook. And Doldam Hospital is on the verge of being sued for malpractice.

Friday is the busiest day as a lot of patients swarm in Doldam Hospital. Eun Jae still finds it hard to perform surgical operations herself. A girl patient who suffers from drug poisoning because of her father's joint family suicidal attempt reminds Woo Jin of a painful memory from his childhood. And the staff of Doldam Hospital resents after hearing a rumor that there will be a new director.

A detective with a gunshot wound and a gang boss with a stab wound come into the ER at the same time. Both of them want Dr. Kim to do the operation, but that's just impossible. Meanwhile, Nurse Oh finds a note at the director's office and notices something is going on with the director. Eun Jae finds a beaten wife in the bathroom and confronts her husband, but something unexpected happens.

Nurse Oh finds out that Director Yeo has lung cancer. A loan shark comes to the hospital and makes a scene to embarrass Woo Jin. Eun Jae feels uncomfortable for causing trouble, so she decides to apologize. Doldam hospital gets a call, and Dr. Kim and Min Guk fiercely conflict over a patient from prison.

Eun Jae loses her confidence from the domestic violence incident, and Dr. Kim cheers her up by telling her that it isn't her fault. A paramedic comes into the ER, unconscious, and she is declared as brain-dead in the end. And the condition of a patient from prison gets worse. Eun Jae finds out that Woo Jin had lost his parents when he was young.

Ujae's at his wits end because he's done everything he can to win Seoyeong's heart. He knows she loves him and her pride and fear are keeping her away. Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing we

Marriage troubles continue between Ujae's parents as their wedding anniversary comes by. Seoyeong gets scouted by Unique Law Firm after the sentencing of her murder trial. She finds it harder by the day to work as a judge. Meanwhile Samjae is continuing to work hard and Sangu's love for Migyeong is deepening. She's worried about telling him the truth whilst Hojeong does what she can to gain some independence from her overly attached mother.

Samjae gets discovered by Ujae and he keeps trying to pay him back for his good dead. Meanwhile Hojeong can't forget Sangu and even proposes to him in the end. Meanwhile, Ujae organizes Seoyeong's father's memorial service at home.

Gyeongho begins work at Sangu and Migyeong's hospital with and air of a love triangle about to blossom. Ujae keeps trying to repay Samjae and even tries to get him a job at the company. Seongjae gets caught for not attending school. And we get a great flashback about the sacrifices that Seoyeong had to make as an older twin...
Lee Soon appoints Maid Choi to the fourth rank concubine. Meanwhile, Prince Dongpyeong confesses to Lee Soon that he loved Ok Jung.

Lee Soon, at Jang Hyeon's request to hold an interrogation, tells him to keep his mouth shut in exchange for making him his father-in-law. Meanwhile, the fourth concubine drinks poisoned rice punch and falls unconscious.

Ok Jung, when Yun falls ill with smallpox, goes to see a shaman with her mother Lady Yoon. Meanwhile, Concubine Choi seeks out the palace office, saying she has an accusation against Ok Jung to announce in front of Lee Soon and the ministers.
Lee Soon gives a decree to Ok Jung for the crimes of setting up an altar and harboring jealousy towards Inhyeon. Meanwhile, Chi Soo asks Ok Jung to be given to him as property.

Yeonwoo, the daughter of the Chief Scholar of Hongmungwan, enters the palace to attend the celebratory banquet honoring her brother's success in the civil service examination. At the same time, Crown Prince Hwon vaults over the wall of Eunwol Pavilion—only to run straight into Yeonwoo. Mistaking him for a thief, Yeonwoo confronts Hwon, but upon noticing the handkerchief he gives her, she realizes he is none other than the Crown Prince.

Yeom, the son of the Chief Scholar, is a man of irresistible charm who, after placing first in the state examination, is appointed as the Crown Prince's tutor. Displeased with his young teacher, Hwon engages in a tense battle of wits with Yeom—unaware that he is Yeonwoo's brother.

Interpersonal relationships are quickly pushed to the edge as a pompous husband, Brian, and his battered wife, Latavia, hold a brunch with unexpected consequences. When their invited guests, Todd and Glenda arrive, inhibitions are lowered, and lingering hostile and dark secrets are revealed. Sex, relationships, class, and revenge are explored over a bit too much wine.

The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

Dr. Blakk and his Darkbane minions have discovered a way to make their ghouls faster and stronger - giving them an edge over the Shane Gang.
Dr. Blakk has succeeded in creating a gap in the magical slug-energy barrier that protects Slugterra!
Eli and the Shane Gang have vanquished Dr. Blakk. But a new threat emerges from beyond the 99 caverns.
The Dark Slinger and his marauders have invaded Slugterra! But there's more to this new threat than meets the eye. Eli must fight a very different kind of duel to save Slugterra...and himself.

A new member joins the Shane Gang! His name is Junjie, and he is a master of the mysterious slugslinging art of Slug Fu. But even with the power of five slingers, the Shane Gang find themselves in over their heads trying to protect the ancient Elemental Slugs.
The Shane Gang and Junjie race across the 99 caverns to keep the Elemental Slugs out of the hands of the Goon.
To save Slugterra and the Elemental Slugs reaches its climax as the Shane Gang face a final showdown.

To master the mysterious slug-slinging art of Slug Fu, Eli must train alone with Junjie. That means leaving behind the rest of the Shane Gang-as well as all of Eli's slugs, and the ultra-powerful Elementals! Pronto vows to keep the Elementals safe, but proves so annoying that they run-er, hop-away!
As Kord, Trixie and Pronto struggle to keep the wily Elemental Slugs out of the wrong hands, Eli and Junjie's Slug Fu training is cut short by a madman.

programmes.st: The Journey to the Eastern Caverns
programmes.d: Eli and the Gang find a way to take Junjie back home to the Eastern Caverns-and find a whole bunch of trouble waiting for them when they get there!

Upon returning to the Outlaws' jungle camp, the Shane Gang suffer a sneak attack from the Emperor's Underlord Holt, who steals almost all of their slugs and loads them onto the Dragon Train for transport to the Emperor. With precious few slugs to use as ammo, the Shane Gang must be extra resourceful to get them back.
In order to reach the Emperor of the Eastern Caverns, Eli and Junjie pose as Underlords to enter the Tournament of Underlords.
In a climactic battle, Junjie and Eli confront the Emperor and the Dai-Fu as the fate of the entire Eastern Caverns hangs in the balance!

While Junjie struggles with the knowledge of what he did during his time as the Dark Slinger, the Shane Gang meet a former servant of the Emperor who wants to turn over a new leaf. But can the Shane Gang help a bad guy learn to do good?

Momma Robotnik forces her son to run for President of Mobius with Wes Weasley as his campaign manager.
Robotnik captures a flute-playing Ninja crane, taps his martial arts knowledge, and transfers it to Scratch and Grounder.
Scratch and Grounder fiddle with Robotnik's Warpinating Warpifier and send Sonic and Tails into the world of a Mobius Fairy Tales book.

programmes.st: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programmes.d: Sonic outsmarts Coconuts, then stumbles into a Convention of Bounty Hunter Robots where Robotnik puts a price on his head. After Sonic defeats all the Robot Bounty Hunters, Robotnik creates Scratch and Grounder to be his S.S.S.S.S. Squad.

Sonic and Tails find an underground world of diamonds, but they are held captive there by a miserly Mole-Troll. When Robotnik comes to capture them, he accidently frees them from the Mole-Troll, who teams up with Sonic and Tails to defend his riches.

Sonic saves a damsel in distress, and falls in love with her, not knowing she's a robot built by Robotnik. But when she has a chance to trap him, she helps him escape, realizing she has fallen for him.

When Scratch and Grounder use Robotnik's new Slo-Mo Ray Gun to capture Sonic, Tails rescues him by reversing the gun and turning it on a tribe of friendly Tree Sloth People who become a high speed commando strike force against Robotnik.

When Robotnik launches a spy-orb that will uncover the Freedom Fighter's Knothole location, Sonic and Robot launch themselves up to the orbiting spy-sphere aboard a home-made rocket powered by Robotnik's discarded booster engine.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

All of Doug's friends have cool bikes, but Doug hates his until he discovers that someone has stolen it. Doug and Judy blow their big chance to stay alone while their parents are on vacation, instead are cursed with a notoriously strict babysitter.

The Beavers become characters in a Mexican wrestling film, starring their wrestling hero, El Grapadura. / The boys battle with a congested bird of prey who moves into the forest and bombards them with loogies.

Norb, who's four minutes older, has always been just a wee bit taller than Dag (something he relishes). His world is turned upside down when Dag shows up for their weekly measuring and has grown to be a wee bit taller than him.
When Eliza accidentally reads Debbie's diary she learns that Debbie thinks she's an embarrassment of a sister. Debbie and Eliza have it out and learn the real truth about their sistership.

When Eliza tries to swim with the humpback whales, Darwin's clumsiness leads to an accident that causes the whales to stop their ritual singing. When Eliza tries to set things right, she is arrested for violating the Marine Mammal Protection Act.

Eliza and her father travel to a cove to film a rare fish,  but Eliza is frightened by strange voices coming from a bog and convinces her father to take a different route. But when Nigel is stung by a deadly fish, Eliza must go back through the bog.

When Eliza meets a group of temple monkeys, they con her into bringing all of her family's food. While Darwin tries to convince her otherwise, Eliza realizes that she's been duped and learns the value of Darwin's friendship.

On a trip to a mountain resort, Tommy develops his first crush on a girl named Olivia.

When Susie gets a gig singing at Slosh Mountain, the world's coolest water park, she gives free tickets to all the Rats. The kids are thrilled, not so much about the show, but about getting the chance to go on the mother of all rides, Whiplash Gorge.

The whole school has caught Yu-Gotta-Go fever... except Chuckie. When he finally starts playing, it becomes an obsession. He becomes one of the school's best players, but in the heat of the game, he almost loses a precious gift.
After Stu sells an invention, he tells the kids that he's splurging on a built-in swimming pool. While digging up the yard, the construction crew unearths the Rats' old mechanical Reptar toy.
A teen magazine runs a “Win a Date with BTR” contest, and the 4 lucky winning girls – each with their own baggage – give the guys serious dating drama.

Lucy, an 18-year-old rocker chick moves into the Palm Woods and she immediately blows the BTR guys away by how cool she is. Carlos and James are desperate to date Lucy, while Kendall tries to prove that BTR can rock too.
BTR refuses to record their second album after Gustavo is too hard on them, and the strike pits the determined band against their stubborn producer in a battle of wills.
While Gustavo struggles to write the band's next hit song, the guys try to cheer up Kendall, who is heartbroken after his break-up with Jo.
Hawk has returned and has a new evil plan to take down Big Time Rush. He plans on stealing BTR's new tracks for their second album and releasing them himself.

Secrets are being kept at the Palm Woods. Kendall and Camille are spending a lot of time together making Logan suspicious. James reveals he never told Carlos that Heather Fox, Carlos' camp crush, liked him.

The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.
Drake wins a free skydive off a helicopter and goes off to do it despite his parents saying no.   Josh, being the good brother he is, tries to stop him, but ends up going along for the ride.
Blessed with his unconventional dance moves, Josh decides to try out for the local dance contest.
Worlds collide when Drake Parker and Josh Nichols, two very different kids attending the same high school, discover that they're about to become stepbrothers.
Drake and Josh get a Dune Buggy that Trevor brought to their house fixed and want to take it out for a spin, but Audrey and Walter think other ways.
After meeting Susan, Drake's new girlfriend, Josh becomes convinced that her flirtation is more than friendly behavior.
When Mr. Nichols boss calls off their dinner plans because of a last minute babysitter cancellation, Josh volunteers his and Drake's services.
True gets a big assignment at work on the same day she goes back to school. True finds it difficult to juggle school and work.
True works up the nerve to ask out her new crush at school, unaware that he has a huge secret that prevents him from getting close to her.
While True and her rap star boyfriend get closer before he must leave for his upcoming tour, a surprise secret admirer vies for her attention.
Mr. Madigan winds up in detention with two of the school's biggest bullies after accidentally eating True's flash drive.
The Rockmores get a brand new television set.  Kel breaks the new TV that Chris was planning on raffling off at Rigby's, so Kenan pulls the old switcheroo.
There's a new girl in school, Becky.  Kel thinks he's head-over-heels in love with her.  Kenan thinks she's a witch and is determined to prove it.
Kenan's new neighbor, the nerdy Marc Cram, loves collecting watches.  Wouldn't you know it -- Kenan's watch goes missing!
Marc Cram is having a birthday bash and has invited everyone, except Kenan.  Kenan is determined to be in attendance at the party, one way or another.

Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.

BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.
After Drake agrees to help Josh with his girl troubles, Josh finds himself promising to play a birthday song at his crush's party.
When the parents leave town for the weekend, Drake and Josh's excitement is stunted when they learn that Grammy is coming to stay.
Drake bets that he can last longer without junk food than Josh can without video games. Who will win.
Drake receives tickets to a concert and a guitar autographed by his idol. Josh accidentally destroys the guitar and to cover it up has to buy a new one.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Takes A Pill
programmes.d: After Barney's New York Creative Director Simon Doonan and Twiggy teach the girls about the different British fashion trends, the competitors are sent to impress top London designers by dressing in each trend.

With only three models remaining, the girls are first challenged to shoot a CoverGirl commercial and a national print ad, and after one competitor is eliminated, legendary photographer Gilles Bensimon shoots each of the final two girls.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Learns How to Dance
programmes.d: The 32 hopeful contestants arrived in a Pasadena hotel to start a runway challenge. Tyra selected the 13 finalists to enter the competition.
After the models battle it out to make the final cut, they are shocked to learn they will be going bald.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Makes The Rules
programmes.d: After the girls are transformed with makeovers, they are put on ice at a photoshoot and face an ice princess back at the house.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Kissed The Roach
programmes.d: Creepy cockroaches and falling fairy tales test the competitors' limits on the catwalk and in their photoshoot.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Kissed a Male Model
programmes.d: The models experience a time for all seasons in a photoshoot after getting tips from supermodel Janice Dickinson

programmes.st: The Girl with Two Bad Takes
programmes.d: The models' improvisational skills are tested in a Covergirl commercial, and one lucky girl wins a guest-starring role on Veronica Mars.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Has a Temper
programmes.d: One model shocks everyone when she loses her temper with another competitor; and at a photoshoot, the girls must model shoes while krumping.
One model faces a surgical procedure, and the models pose in a black and white photo directed by Tyra Banks.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Is A Model, Not A Masseuse
programmes.d: The participants are taught how to handle challenging interview questions and after a trip overseas the models must pose upside down as mermaids.

programmes.st: The Girl Who is Going to the Moon
programmes.d: Never-before-seen footage.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Is Rushed To The Emergency Room
programmes.d: One model is suddenly rushed to the emergency room and the girls must post on top of an elephant.

Dylan is tricked by Rev and kidnapped. The crew finds an "unexpected ally" in a Collector.

programmes.st: Lost in a Space That Isn't There
programmes.d: The Abyss has infected Beka. The crew must find a way to save her.
After some of the crew is captured, Harper is forced to work on a time bridge for the Patriarch.
A spy from Tri Gemma shows up on the Andromeda in an attempt to steal the Star Map.
When Rommie becomes too emotional, the ship cuts her access in order to run diagnostics. This leaves the ship vulnerable to a Magog attack.
The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors, and Dylan escapes into the Route of Ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra, and locates the Meethus Diagram - but has no idea what it does.
A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 1
programmes.d: Chili Pepper suddenly appears before Josuke to test his Stand powers. Josuke puts up a fight but is overwhelmed by Chili Pepper’s power. The next day, Josuke and friends learn from Jotaro that a man who can locate Chili Pepper is heading to Morioh

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and his friends gather at the Port to try and reach Joseph Joestar before Chili Pepper. Speculating the enemy is hiding nearby, Jotaro orders Josuke and Koichi to stay behind and find Chili Pepper’s user while he and Okuyasu go protect Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
programmes.d: With Akira Otoishi arrested and the bow and arrow safely recovered, peace seemingly returns to Morioh. But Josuke’s life is far from peaceful as he struggles to deal with his father, whose old age is making things difficult for them to bond.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.d: Koichi and Hazamada visit the home of Rohan Kishibe, a popular manga artist whom they are huge fans of. Much to their joy, Rohan not only agrees to sign autographs but also invites them to take a tour of his workspace.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.d: Koichi is drawn back to Rohan’s house, where he sees the manga artist finishing up his next manga at an incredible speed. Rohan uses his stand Heaven’s Door on Koichi again to gain further creative inspiration from the young boy’s life experience.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go Hunting!
programmes.d: Jotaro and Josuke must hunt down a rat that is believed to have become a Stand user after being shot by the bow and arrow. When the two arrive at the site, they find dozens of dead rats killed in the most bizarre fashion.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
programmes.d: Koichi and Rohan discover a small alley that does not appear to be listed anywhere on the map. The two decide to go into the alley to see where it leads but soon find themselves walking around in circles and unable to get out.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
programmes.d: Josuke and Okuyasu become friends with a Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangu, a.k.a. Shigechi, who can use his Stand to find and collect the money that is scattered across town. Impressed by the boy’s abilities.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and friends try to cash in the winning lottery ticket they found. However, the bank clerk is not convinced they’re the actual owners of the ticket, placing the three teens into a tough spot as they try to talk their way through their big lie.

Sonny Drysdale decides he needs to be Pygmalion to Elly's Galatea and remake her from a hillbilly into a woman of society, while Granny uses love charms to heat up their relationship.

Jed, Ellie May, Jethro, and Granny take their first plane flight back home for Christmas to visit cousin Pearl, who is busy cooking up a feast to win Mr. Brewster's unwilling heart.
Back home for Christmas, Elly May bonds with her old animal friends, while Pearl plays the piano for the "new" movie in town (the silent version of Ben Hur) to impress Mr. Brewster.

Since Mr. Brewster doesn't want to get married, but since the whole county knows that Cousin Pearl had her hat set for him, Jed comes up with a plan for her to save face by having Mr. Brewster proposed in public and then have her turn him down

With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
Frank mobilizes the entire NYPD to find the killer of an off-duty police officer who was murdered during a diamond heist.
Danny works to discover the source of a deadly narcotic after three teenagers die from a drug overdose.
Hoss is conned into buying a violin from a gypsy fortune teller, and everyone on the Ponderosa--except for Hop Sing--suffers the consequences.
The Ponderosa hands are upset when new hand George Whitman is hired on, it is rumored he is a jinx.  Hoss tells George to ignore such foolishness, but a gypsy fortune teller says otherwise.

Virginia City's newest preacher is an ex-gunfighter who wants only to build a new church, but the brother of one of his victims has other ideas.  The blueprints for the church are said to be a gift from Adam.

A judge awards itinerant horse breeder Jim Acton's beloved mare to rancher Sam Whipple. Jim tries to buy her back, but Whipple refuses his offer, after which a fight ensues and Jim kills Whipple in self-defense.
Billy Horne is a white man who was captured by the Shoshone when he was six. He comes into Ben & Joe's campsite one night uninvited.

Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living.  Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City.  In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.

programmes.st: Dark Enough to See the Stars
programmes.d: Young Billy Wilcox wanders onto the Ponderosa, sick, hungry, and alone.  Ben finds him, and after he regains his strength, offers Billy a job.

Hoss chooses a difficult path when he decides to rehabilitate a famous poet, Will Smith, who is really William Warlock Evans, who spends too much time drinking and eventually his wife arrives at the Ponderosa.
Ladies' man Lothario Larkin creates havoc whenever he hits Virginia City, so Roy Coffee orders him out of town.  Naturally, Hoss takes him in.
The town council feels Roy Coffee can no longer do his job, and with the notorious Wagner gang on their way to rob the bank, everyone is in a panic.
Little Joe's 19-year old girlfriend is killed by a good samaritan, an explosives expert who had stopped to render aid to the woman's uncle after he suffers a stroke.
Mateo Ibara and his wife Carla visit the Ponderosa.  Ibara asks Will to return to Mexico with him. Ibara and Will fought together for Juarez's cause and Ibara saved Will's life.
Classic comedy in which Hoss first meets prospector Obie and his lazy but allegedly brilliant mongrel dog, Walter.
Adam encounters drunken artist James Callan, branded a "squaw man" because he is married to an Indian, and whose talent is going to waste in the town of Sheep Head.
Sumire is able to escape with Nue´s help and begins searching for Wasabi and Namida and then Jugo´s friends Suigetsu and Karin suddenly appear.

Sarada and Karin struggle with fighting an enemy who is able to manipulate the power of the Curse Mark at will. Sumire fights alongside Nue to protect everyone, but Nue starts losing control of its powers.
Boruto and Suigetsu want to help Jugo, but they cannot due to the sedatives they were given. At the same time, the birds with the Curse Mark start flocking together to start their migration!

Team 7 is sent on a mission to help capture a jewelry thief, but they lose track of them. In the thief´s place, a cat appears. Boruto and the others decide that Mitsuki should take care of it for the time being.
Mitsuki visits Orochimaru´s research facility because he´s not feeling well. Mitsuki explains to Orochimaru and Log that he never used to dream during sleep, but has recently begun to have them.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The S-Rank Mission!
programmes.d: Konohamaru´s cousin, Mirai Sarutobi, is assigned to escort the Sixth Hokage Kakashi and his friend Might Guy to the hot springs.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Dog and Cat War!
programmes.d: Mirai and crew arrive at the hot springs located near the border of the Land of Fire and the Land of Steam in time for a festival celebrating dogs and cats.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Haunted Inn!
programmes.d: A few days into the mission, Mirai visits the hot spring with Tenten, Guy´s former student. But that moment of relaxation is interrupted by Guy yelling about a ghost.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Potato Chips and the Giant Boulder!
programmes.d: Mirai, Kakashi, and Guy travel with Tatsumi to a village with a secret hot spring, but they find the hot spring covered by a boulder!

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Resurrection Hot Springs!
programmes.d: Moved by Tatsumi´s efforts to accomplish her goal all by herself, Mirai decides to help her even though she's still in the middle of her mission.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Mirai's King!
programmes.d: Mirai leaves the inn with Tatsumi without telling Kakashi and Guy. At the hot springs Mirai thinks she sees her father Asuma, but something feels off.
Naruto and Shikamaru deliberate on the results of the Chunin Exam that were left unsettled due to the Otsutsuki attack.
With Shikadai as captain, Boruto, Iwabe, and Wasabi form a special team for a mission to find and bring back a rare flower that only blooms for a short period of time.
As Boruto and his friends eagerly collect Extreme Ninja Cards, they realize they are still missing their former teacher, Shino Aburame, and Metal´s father, Rock Lee!
Kakashi goes to the post office disguised as Sukea, a freelance journalist to observe Team 25, whose mission is to assist with sorting mail.
Boruto and Konohamaru rescue Remon Yoimura from an attack.
Boruto and Konohamaru pay a visit to Remon's village, but are puzzled by Remon's cold demeanor.
Konohamaru tries to rescue Remon by checking up on Kankitsu, but he is caught and forcibly taken back to the Leaf Village.
Konohamaru and Boruto set out again to rescue Remon but find they've arrived a little late. Soma has broken the seal and begins his resurrection
When Sasuke sends a message home, Boruto takes a peek at its contents and learns that Sasuke will be making a stop at a certain location in the Land of Wind.

programmes.st: The Entrusted Mission: Protect the One Tails!
programmes.d: Boruto manages to reach Sasuke, but he sees his mentor disappear before his very eyes due to an attack by Urashiki Otsutsuki.
Led by Kankuro, Boruto and Shinki guard Shukaku and head for the Hidden Leaf Village. But on the way, they engage with a puppet created by the Otsutsuki Clan sent after them in pursuit
Boruto and Shinki clash, and they ultimately end up going their separate ways. But an Otsutsuki puppet appears before Shinki.
Boruto and Shinki manage to slip away from Urashiki, but escaping him completely proves to be difficult.
Urashiki is determined to get Shukaku's chakra and attacks ruthlessly. Boruto and Shinki form a united front and unleash each of their special jutsu
Boruto and Shinki bring Shukaku to Hidden Leaf Village. Upon arriving at the Uzumaki home, Himawari is completely taken with him.
Boruto becomes fascinated by Jiraiya, Naruto's former mentor.
Boruto is forbidden to participate in the counterattack on Urashiki because he was previously targeted by the Otsutsuki.

programmes.st: The Village Hidden in the Leaves
programmes.d: While chasing down Urashiki, Boruto and Sasuke get hit with a strange Otsutsuki weapon.
Boruto and Sasuke end up staying in the Hidden Leaf under the watchful eyes of Naruto and Jiraiya.

programmes.st: The Power of the Nine Tails
programmes.d: Urashiki appears to steal the chakra of Nine Tails from Naruto, but his attempt is unsuccessful.
At Jiraiya�s suggestion, Boruto and Naruto train to synchronize their chakra, but this turns out to be more difficult than expected.
Boruto and Naruto resume their training.

When a teenager and her sister are the sole survivors of the gruesome murder of four members of one family in a quiet suburban neighborhood, Grissom and his entire team investigate the crime.

Royce Harmon was murdered 3 months ago in a scene staged to look like a suicide. Now another murder has taken place. Whoever the killer is he has a thorough knowledge of forensics, he purposefully has left evidence, and has baffled Grissom and his team.
Grissom and his team investigate the death of a first class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas.
Grissom and Sara investigate a bug riddled body found in the desert. Warrick and Catherine look into the theft of some valuable art.
A woman is abducted from a supermarket. In the store, Grissom finds a bathroom stall door that claims five women have been killed.
A man about to go on trial for arson and the murder of his wife and child seeks assistance from Grissom to help prove his innocence.
A bomb goes off in an office building, killing one and injuring many more. The chief suspect is a security guard who left minutes before the explosion and has knowledge in bomb making.
When a single human bone is discovered in the desert, Grissom and Catherine must cover miles of territory to find the rest of the skeleton.
At a swanky fundraiser, attended by the sheriff, a woman turns up dead in the pool.
A woman is abducted from a mall parking garage. She's raped, beaten, shot and left for dead. Sara collects evidence from her and grows attached to her.
A body is found in a pottery store in what's apparently a robbery that was interrupted.
A couple leaving a restaurant on their anniversary are killed in the street and their car is stolen. The crime scene is compromised when it rains shortly after the CSIs arrive.
The entire team investigates the abduction of the infant child of a well-to-do family. Suspicion immediately falls on the child's parents.
Two teenage girls run over a deaf man with their car, but they didn't kill him - he was already dead.
Grissom, Nick, and Warrick take the case of a jogger who was killed by a wild animal in the park. It gets complicated when they discover that the jogger had his liver removed after he was killed.
Miami’s club scene turns deadly when underage drinking sparks a bloody murder in a bathroom stall, Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
A jury field trip to the scene of a murder flips the legal tables when the defendant ends up dead and the twelve jurors become the prime suspects.
A “Speed Dating” night for Miami singles turns deadly for one South Beach stud who finds himself on the wrong end of a tire iron.
Miami Beach is evacuated for a tsunami, but the CSI team remains after discovering a bank robbery plot while investigating a seemingly random murder.
A string of dead bodies, found off the coast of Miami, turns out to be the work of modern-day pirates. Horatio and the team investigate.
An innocent man is killed when someone falls on him from a balcony. The CSI team is lead into the center of a high-level sex and murder scandal.
A seemingly random carjacking turns out to be anything but when a young woman's gambling addiction becomes more than the family business can support.
A hospital emergency room shootout investigation puts the CSI team in the middle of a murder case involving the leader of a prominent street gang
A routine traffic stop ends in the murder of a patrolman. The CSI team must sort out a young girl's obsessive love affair in order to find the killer.
A "Friction Party" at a private suite in one of the city's hotels accommodating hundreds of cruise passengers leaves a young woman dead.
Horatio faces a former nemesis who escaped his grasp once before, a case of stolen identity leads to murder, the question becomes "which one did it?"

The sisters are sent back in time on Halloween to save a baby from being born into the clutches of evil. Meanwhile, Leo and Darryl are left to keep the grimlocks at bay until the sisters return.

After the manor is burglarized, Prue, Phoebe, and Piper become obsessed with learning more about the elusive evil force that is hunting them. Prue assumes it is demonic, but Darryl cautions them that there is human evil as well.

Phoebe and Piper are on a mission to save Prue after a spell for an innocent horribly backfires and Prue is given the unwanted gift of feeling all the pain in the world. The cacophony of human emotion will most certainly crush her.
Cole uses petty anger between Prue, Phoebe, and Piper to break their bond and destroy the very foundation of their powers, leaving the sisters defenseless against demonic attack.

After Prue, Phoebe, and Piper learn that Cole is the demon that has been trying to kill them, Phoebe faces the tough decision of killing the man she loves or defying her sisters by letting him go free

Piper is consumed with insecurities over her impending 10-year high school reunion, but when a she-demon unexpectedly takes possession, Piper becomes very Coyote Ugly and it is up to Prue and Phoebe to bring her back.

programmes.st: We All Scream For Ice Cream
programmes.d: Prue has a melody in her head and when she sees a girl humming the tune, she finds that it belongs to the ice-cream truck.
The sisters must stop a warlock from executing his plan to steal specific powers from witches in his attempt to kill every whitelighter in the world.
When Prue discovers that one of her ex-boyfriends is being led down the path to becoming a demon, she, Piper and Phoebe risk their lives in an underworld wrestling ring to save his soul.
Phoebe and Piper are lured to the dark side and relish their new evil powers when a shapeshifting warlock tricks Prue into a shot-gun wedding in an effort to steal the Book of Shadows.

programmes.st: The Good, The Bad & The Cursed
programmes.d: Phoebe somehow becomes psychically and physically linked with the violent past of an Old West ghost town complete with horses, petticoats, cowboys and six-shooters and Prue must go back in time to save her sister from a horrifying fate.

Piper is praying for a demon-free wedding day, but Prue's astral self has other plans as dreams take her into a wild world without rules and responsibility that affect reality when the police arrest Prue on suspicion of murder.

Prue is tired of losing her battle to save innocents, and in her effort to fight off the Angel of Death, she has to turn her back on a dying soul when she accepts that she can't fight fate and reconciles with the death of her mother.

Piper and Leo feel lack of privacy and decide to move to a rented apartment. When they tell Prue and Phoebe, the Halliwell sisters recall their troubled relationship with their grandmother Penny before they acknowledge that they were The Charmed Ones
A demon wielding the seven deadly sins uses his powers against The Charmed Ones, and after only a few hours exposed to Pride, Gluttony, Lust and Sloth, Phoebe, Prue, Piper, and Leo may self-destruct.

programmes.st: The Demon Who Came In From The Cold
programmes.d: Cole officially joins the good fight when he goes undercover in an underworld brotherhood to help Prue, Phoebe, Piper, and Leo learn more about the evil. Their trust in him falters when it looks as though they are being double-crossed.

Phoebe is worried when her love, Cole stays undercover in a demon Brotherhood, but the danger turns dire when Cole's old mentor plots to bring out his evil side and turn his massive powers against the Charmed Ones.

Sam and Diane are forced to come to grips with their feelings about each other when Diane's relationship with Sam's brother grows more serious.

Diane doesn't tell Sam that she is going out to dinner with her ex-fiancé Sumner and his wife, because she thinks he will embarrass her if he comes along.
Carla's new love interest could die from too much excitement.
Sam's newly divorced friend tries to come between him and Diane.
Coach sports an attitude when he coaches a little-league team.
Dick Cavett visits Cheers and suggests Sam publish his own writings.

Diane is furious, when she sees that Sam and her old school chum find each other very attractive.

Carla shows up at her ex-husband's wedding with Sam as her date.
Sam questions Norm's abilities when he hires him as an accountant.
Diane and Sam try to get Coach out of their hair by arranging a double date.

Coach brings fortunes to Cheers when he buys an antique scale.
Diane forbids Sam to go on an annual ski trip with his buddies.
Coach is hurt when he learns that his deceased friend once propositioned his wife.
Norm tries to prove his manliness when his new client makes advances.
Sam hires a brilliant artist to paint Diane as a peace offering.
Diane defends her relationship with Sam to a slandering artist.

In the aftermath of their explosive separation, Sam has fallen off the wagon with a thud and has returned to his playboy ways, while Diane has just returned from a self-imposed rest at Golden Brook Sanitarium.
After several sessions with Dr. Frasier Crane, Sam is getting his life back in order, so Diane feels it's time to tell him the truth about her relationship with the psychiatrist.
Sam gloats when he has reason to believe that Diane is still in love with him.
Frasier asks Sam to escort Diane to an event while he is out of town.
Sam reaps the consequences of getting involved with a married woman.
Coach proposes marriage when he falls in love at first sight.
After Coach's girlfriend Irene wins the lottery, she becomes a socialite and breaks up with him.

The recruits make exotic burgers and learn to fillet a whole cod.
The four recruits face the last Skill Drill and cook for their loved ones.
The final recruits battle to see which cook has gone from worst to best.
The new recruits learn fast that boot camp is no walk down the red carpet.

Celebrity recruits are put to the test and teams must replicate a recipe.
The remaining celebrities turn the tables and give their mentors a lesson.
The celebrity recruits cook a simple recipe that's missing some key words.
The last two recruits cook a restaurant-quality meal for culinary experts.
We revisit the craziest and messiest moments in the show's history!
Two hopeless cooks want to host a holiday dinner for their entire family.
The recruits kick off boot camp with a shrimp and live lobster challenge.
The teams get cracking with the most important meal of the day: breakfast.
Mark returns to a rebuilt lake house to see the finished product.
The Barnwood Builders face gutsy gambles and treacherous take-downs.
Mark and the guys help folks save and restore antique cabins.
The team turns a Pennsylvania barn into a stunning guest home in New York.
Tim and Alex share their hilarious journey from enemies to good friends.
Sherman Thompson is a leader, a craftsman and an unstoppable workhorse.
This special episode takes an in-depth look at craftsman Graham Ferguson.
Rediscover favorite moments in this special dedicated to our biggest fans.
The guys welcome a new member and build a custom timber frame and cabin.
The builders work on endless tasks as Mark visits one of his first cabins.
The crew visits Johnny Jett's hometown of Morehead, KY, to save a barn.
The crew visits Eagle Rock, VA, to build a dogtrot cabin in the mountains.
The crew saves a cabin with incredible stone work in New Freeport, PA.
The guys salvage five barns in Alton, VA, and Mark hunts for more in PA.
It's a week of surprises as the Builders tackle two projects in Virginia.
The Builders save the barn that inspired Mark Bowe to start his business.
The Builders teach two young apprentices how to build a timber frame barn.
The Builders restore a timber frame home on a frozen field in WV.
The Builders take on a giant wedding pavilion designed by Karen Tillery.
In Kentucky, the Builders help Sherman build a family fishing cabin.

The Builders must dig into their bag of tricks on a mountain cabin jobsite.
In this provocatively daring film, an attention-seeking schoolgirl vengefully spreads rumors that her teachers (Audrey Hepburn and Shirley MacLaine) are lesbians.
Based on William Inge's classic play, Come Back, Little Sheba is the stirring tale of a life-weary couple who rescue hope from the ruins of the past.

Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

In this riotously funny farce, Peter Sellers introduced the world to Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case, who is out to stop the notorious Phantom (David Niven) from stealing the priceless Pink Panther diamond!

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.
In the 1800's, an East Indies shipping tycoon and the swash-buckling captain of a trading vessel, The Red Witch, battle for gold, priceless pearls, and the love of a beautiful woman.
A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

programmes.t: The Russians Are Coming, The Russians Are Coming
programmes.d: Alan Arkin and Jonathan Winters lead an all-star cast (Carl Reiner, Eva Marie Saint, Brian Keith, Theodore Bikel) in this outrageous comedy about a Russian submarine that runs aground off the New England coast.
Paul Newman delivers an inspiring performance as a resistance fighter who helps rescue 600 Jews from detention camps which results in the rebirth of an entire nation.
Arthur performs an operation he will remember all his life, when his famous practical-joking college roommate becomes more than just another patient.

Walter's out of town and Maude's life is threatened by an oversexed housepainter. With Arthur on night duty at the hospital, Maude and Vivian barricade themselves in the house and drink a little wine to ward off the cold. and a severe case of hysteria.
Maude is ecstatic over the prospect of seeing a close friend at their college class reunion, but when her friend arrives in a wheelchair, Maude heads straight for the punchbowl.
Maude's investigation into Vivian's erratic behavior reveals a new part of the Harmon's marriage and almost all of Vivian.
Maude's Aunt Lola, who is irresistible to married men -- and vice versa -- zeros in on Mrs. Naugatuck's husband, Bert, as her next conquest.
When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

Mechanic Latka Gravas frantically works to save the cracked-up Cab 804 as the cabbies fondly recall times in the legendary auto when Alex delivered a baby, Louie beat a rich brat out of a wad of money, and Elaine met the perfect man.
It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.
The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.
Felix is forced to depend on Oscar's help in the finals of the Golden Apron cooking contest.

programmes.st: Bunny Is Missing Down by the Lake
programmes.d: Felix and Oscar spend a rainy weekend in the country looking for a lost girl
Felix tries to make up with his divorced wife with a sentimental reminder of happier days.
Oscar develops a strong attachment for Felix's doctor, an attractive young woman.
Robbie and a friend decide to start raising pigs for profit.
Mike's Air Reserve squadron falls apart during his absence.
Bub wins a contest on TV.
The boys must take care of a bird and a girl.
Rob faces a dilemma when an old army pal must be told he cannot attend a special dinner party that the Petries are throwing for a sponsor of 'The Alan Brady Show.'
Rob makes the mistake of trying to help the old-time radio comedy writer who gave him his first break.
Ritchie adopts two baby ducks and Rob faces the task of making him understand the consequence of trying to keep pets that may be happier living in the wild.
To prove that a wife cannot always recognize her husband on the telephone, Rob disguises his voice and asks Laura on a date.
Uncle Joe leads a delegation out to Washington, D.C., to save Sam Ducker's post office.
Steve Elliott is declared out of bounds in his house when it appears his baby daughter is allergic to him.
Lazy Uncle Joe, who fancies himself a human dynamo, announces his retirement.
The Hooterville folks are faced with a larcenous fund-raiser when they try to find enough money to buy the church a new organ.
The future of the Shady Rest hangs on the outcome of a race between the Cannonball and an overland taxi.
Steve Elliott hurriedly takes off on a crop-dusting job, not knowing he underbid for the assignment by $1800.
Gomer's acts of kindness towards his new waitress friend is mistaken for romantic interest by her cruel Marine Sergeant boyfriend.
Grandma Pyle visits Gomer, reads his fortune and predicts Gomer will cause something bad to happen; then Sergeant Carter loses his voice while yelling at him.
A Colonel and his young daughter are visiting Camp Henderson. While befriending the little girl, Pyle has no problem getting her and himself in trouble with everyone.
Sgt. Carter is chosen to appear in a documentary but becomes an absurd camera hog, leaving producers no choice but to follow Gomer performing punishments Carter doles out.
After a pay phone spits out $41.75 in coins, Duke and Frankie are ecstatic about all the fun they can have spending it, but good Samaritan Gomer is determined to return it to the phone company.

Gomer wins a trip for two to Las Vegas and takes Sergeant Carter with him. The Sergeant has no money so he has to rely on Gomer for entertainment but Gomer has set an itinerary which include things like visiting a Rock Museum.

Two very different victims are murdered: one a very rich foreign businessman found knifed; the other a poor black police informant found shot in a phone booth. Meanwhile, a Japanese industrialist is also found dead.
A gang of hijackers steals more than they bargained for. The gold they have stolen is mixed with deadly uranium.
Mannix is hired by the sister of Geoffrey Paradine, a college student who has disappeared. As the episode opens, Mannix is taken off the case because she claims to have found him.
A group of prisoners on death row in a prison near Lawson City stage a takeover, taking as a hostage a guard named Charlie Keefer, who is a friend of Joe Mannix.
Victor Brady, a leader in the electronics business, runs up a gambling debt of nearly $250,000 to a Las Vegas casino. Brady's private plane disappears from the radar on its way back to Los Angeles.
Mannix is able to escape from a desert dinner being held by gunmen, only to return with the law and find the couple running it, deny any such incident happened.
J.R. gets involved in a dangerous situation when an old friend tells him that her ex-husband is stalking her and their son and using his influence as a police officer to do it.
Betty goes under hypnosis so she can remember the events that led up to a car accident that killed her friend and caused her to lose her memory-and realizes it was no accident.
In the course of investigating the death of a film editor, Barnaby and J.R. uncover a movie pirating operation that could potentially cost the studio millions in lost revenue.

Betty investigates an academy for girls where a series of accidents have injured instructors and students alike. What she finds is a vicious group of girls who dominate the school through fear and intimidation tactics.
Working with a Tokyo police officer, Five-O's Steve McGarrett tries to locate the source of a gun smuggling ring which is sending handguns to Japan.
Steve McGarrett searches for both a maniacal rapist-murderer and the district attorney's daughter who is lost in the mountains of Oahu, fearful in the meantime that they will encounter one another.
Hit-and-run kills police officer, driver turns out to be head of Honolulu gambling syndicate. Only witness, debt-ridden gambler, extorts driver with knowledge of crime.
Barnard Hughes guest stars as a 71-year-old walking bomb who is threatening to blow himself up along with a group of hostages if his demands to stop the demolition of his home are not met.

While vacationing in Hawaii, a popular female country singer is kidnapped for $500,000 ransom, and as McGarrett's Five-O force begins investigating, it appears that the victim and her abductors have perished at sea.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Ray Garrett was convicted of murdering his wife's lover. Pleading his innocence from the start, he was still convicted of the crime and sentenced to death. Will time run out for the death row prisoner as the Sparta police attempt to save his life?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Terry and Derek Johnson are two brothers at odds with each other. Terry makes good grades and has a scholarship waiting for him, but Derek has chosen to deal drugs. When a local boy dies of an overdose, Gillespie wants Derek charged with murder.
Hunter is frustrated in his pursuit of a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to systematically kill the participants in the man's trial.
Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison.

Dr. Sloan's day begins with a phone call from a kidnapper who happened to dial the wrong number - his! The kidnapper believes he's called the original victim and demands Dr. Sloan deliver money if he wants to see his son alive.

A homicide investigation turns into a federal case when a "corpse" creates a reign of terror at Community General. Amanda prepares for her autopsy on blood-soaked John Doe when he springs to life, putting a stranglehold on Amanda!
After heading out to a mountain cabin, Jesse goes missing, only to turn up five days later in Utah, claiming to have been abducted by aliens.

Members of a high school football team are being blackmailed to throw an upcoming game. The team's coach is murdered when he learns of the blackmail. Walker and Trivette must break up the gambling ring before the state championship game.

It appears that Indian spirits are protecting Indian burial land. Witnesses report that spirits appear, frighten, and attack those who get in the way. Walker seeks help from the Indian Tribe to learn how to fight evil spirits.

A convict seeks forgiveness from those he did wrong. He contacts Walker and tells him that the person who killed Walker's parents is still alive. Walker tracks down the killer to have him finally get his punishment in court.

A well-liked woman in a small town is murdered, and townsfolk suspect a slow-minded man. The sheriff calls the Rangers to help prevent a lynching. Walker and Trivette must find the real killer before the angry town hangs the innocent man.
Kimble saves the life of Maggie Tippet, the one-armed man's girlfriend.
Richard Kimble and a sheriff's girlfriend are surprised by three criminals while caring for their wounded cohort.

programmes.st: The Other Side Of The Coin
programmes.d: Working at a small-town market, Kimble is held up by a fellow employee, who also happens to be the local sheriff's son.

A head injury resulting from a confrontation with hitmen who fear MacGyver knows too much about their assassination plot against the leaders of the Omega Forceanti-terrorist brigade, causes MacGyver (Richard Dean Anderson) to lose his memory.
MacGyver travels to Czechoslovakia to rescue a dissident from the top-security psychiatric ward of a Czech hospital.

In the wilderness, MacGyver and 10-year-old Darin Cooper intervene to save the lives of a pair of golden eagles injured by poachers. The poachers go after MacGyver -- witness to their crime -- and taking Darin and his mother hostage.
Dr. Sloan insists that a man he helped condemn to death for a series of bombings is guilty, even after a post-execution explosion.
Three months after the execution of Lewis Sweeney, explosions are still rocking the LA area every four days. The unpopular Dr. Sloan continues his efforts to nail Carter Sweeney for the bombings.
Chip's friend spends all his time with a new kid.
Bub misses his rendezvous with a legendary fish.
Mr. Wilson takes over an advice-to-the-lovelorn newspaper column for a few weeks, thinking he will have every single woman in town happily married by the time he finishes.
Mr. Wilson believes that a hermit Dennis visits at his shack out in the woods fought in the Civil War, so he tries to get his life story.
Mr. Wilson has written a book about his Uncle Ned's life, but Ned does not want the book to be published.
Mr. Wilson is named chairman of a saving-stamps campaign for the Junior Astronauts and arranges a contest at Dennis' school to win a trip to Cape Canaveral to meet an astronaut.
After Kathy breaks another window, Jim is committed to teaching his kids about personal responsibility.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: A Friend Of Old George's
programmes.d: The family has a lovely dinner and special event planned for Kathy's birthday. She's been looking forward to it, but an uninvited visitor upsets the best-laid plans.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Bud The Snob
programmes.d: Bud is getting a reputation as a snob; his difficulty in talking with girls is being misinterpreted as standoffishness.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Promised Playhouse
programmes.d: Jim demands that his family start living up to the promises they've made to people.

The kids overhear Bill talking about one of his bridges collapsing. He goes to the construction site to help with the disaster. The kids think they are going to lose all their money to help pay for the bridge.
Bill gets a job in England which seems like it might last a year. Everyone plans to move, but then it seems like Bill won't be able to go.
The twins start using a tape recorder to record conversations other people have in private.
Uncle Bill takes everyone on vacation to Spain. As they start the great vacation, Mr. French and the twins get separated. Bill and Cissy join Mr. French in the search for Buffy and Jody.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.

Greg steals the mascot from his rival school the night before the big game, and Mike tries to help him return it before he gets in big trouble.
Marcia, Jan and Peter each get jobs at the local ice cream parlor, each with varying results.

Bobby saves Peter from potential serious injury after he pushes him out of the way of a falling ladder. A grateful Peter offers to become Bobby's "slave for life," something that Bobby takes quick advantage of.

With the TV broken, Edith decides to buy a new one for Archie for their 30th wedding anniversary. But when the clerk won't let Edith buy a TV without Archie's signature because she's a woman, she goes to the bank for a loan.
Edith finally confronts the waitress who tempted Archie's fidelity after Harry unwittingly hires her to work at Archie's Place.
When Edith develops laryngitis on the eve of her singing debut at Stephanie's PTA recital, Archie steps in to understudy the duet.
Edith is arrested for passing phony $10 bills she got from Archie's Place.
After Mike and Gloria cancel their trip home for Christmas, the Bunkers decide to travel west for the holidays.
After going to a cousin's funeral, Mama plans a suitable funeral for herself. However, it will require their savings for vacation and for her to bow out of the bowling competition.
When Mama claims to have a date for Valentine's Day, Iola resorts to "Rent A Gent," but she gets a much younger and much better looking escort than she expected.
While Mama disputes a bill, the electric company turns the power off—the night that Bubba has to finish a paper on Abraham Lincoln and Iola is up for an award at the Food Circus.
Mama finally gets the house to herself when everyone goes away for the weekend. But the peace and quiet is far from the paradise she expects.
It's April Fool's Day, and Mama is in a foul mood. She hates practical jokes but gets the last laugh on the rest of the family when she pulls the best joke ever.

A look at the case of James Allen Selby, a serial rapist who eluded police for years while attacking 11 women in five states - Oklahoma, Nevada, California, Arizona, and Colorado.

A 'perfect cover' becomes a foul frame-up when Steve Sloan is accused of murder! Staging various crimes in their off-hours with perfect success, four corrupt police officers think they have it made - until one of them commits a homicide.

A 'perfect cover' becomes a foul frame-up when Steve Sloan is accused of murder! Staging various crimes in their off-hours with perfect success, four corrupt police officers think they have it made - until one of them commits a homicide.

A box of mutilated flowers and slashed photos drives pop-singer Shanda into a state of shock. After she collapses and her road tour grinds to a halt, Dr. Mark Sloan takes pity on Shanda and embarks on a search to find her mysterious stalker.

Still groggy from a visit to the dentist, Dr. Sloan is mystified when a noted fund-raiser dies while visiting his home. Adding to the confusion, the body mysteriously disappears before the police get there!
Dr. Sloan's free tickets to a friend's magic show become an invitation to murder when the magician mysteriously dies on stage in the middle of his escape act!

A romance in bloom is nipped in the bud when Steve's new girlfriend is charged with murder. An instructor of modern dance, Cindy is shocked to learn she's being charged with killing one of the owners of the studio where she works.
A cruel collage prank comes back to haunt four young women in later life. Although Amanda had almost forgotten it, a recent letter brings back the unpleasant memory.
Surprise, surprise! While investigating the murder of a call-girl, Dr. Sloan is caught in the middle of a vice raid!

Dr. Sloan becomes involved in more than politics when he accepts an invitation to attend an election campaign party. A face in a crowd of well-wishers awakens old memories for Mayor Ridgeway's wife, Lauren, with murderous results.

Always trying to help out a friend, Jack Stewart offers his support when a con-man acquaintance tries to straighten out his life. Instead, Jack's entwined in a mysterious fatal car accident investigation involving a posh health spa.
A tense situation erupts into a hotbed of chaos! While awaiting treatment from Dr. Sloan, convicted criminal John Dunbar unexpectedly jumps his guards and seizes a gun.

A devastating earthquake causes widespread damage and Dr. Sloan's hospital goes on emergency power. After the tremors stop, Mark's friend Martin Garfield is found dead in the ruins of his mansion nearby. Was it the earthquake or murder?
Steve's undercover waterfront surveillance causes city-wide panic. His suspect, a gangland hit man, has suddenly developed the plague!
Posing as a visiting missionary, Dr. Sloan goes undercover at a convent to reveal the location and contents of a most mysterious package - a parcel that brought its owner to a sudden, untimely death.
It's double trouble for Dr. Sloan in this second season premiere. What could be worse than an IRS tax audit?

While confronting board members about embezzled charity funds, chairman Elton Malone mysteriously keels over dead. And, one by one, all of the suspects also wind up murdered--at each other's funerals!

When Dr. Sloan's wealthy womanizing patient, Robert Stroud, mysteriously disappears, Sloan uncovers a greedy plot hatched by the women in Stroud's life. It's a murderous plan ripe with blackmail and betrayal--and a shockingly twisted conclusion!

Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.

Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.

Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
