Cassy is assigned to tend the school garden, where she discovers that the flowers are shrinking instead of growing. While trying to save a flower, she's yanked into “Rootopia,” – a bizarre underground realm.

Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.
Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother, Sheryl (Rachael Harris), died to see if she's now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret he overheard Sam and Jay discussing to his fellow ghosts.
When Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they're shocked to discover that she's communicating with someone they know on a dating app.
Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.st: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
programmes.d: A séance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.
Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys' house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.
When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

Alberta's past expertise comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into complications during their Woodstone whiskey-tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac's past.
Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

programmes.d: Spydra journeys back to 15th-century Florence, Italy in an attempt to steal Leonardo da Vinci's famous perpetual motion machine, not realizing his inventions only exist on paper.
Spydra sends her minion, Boris, to find the largest antennae in order to cast herself over every television in the world and teach children to love her!

programmes.st: An Ice Age Runs Through It
programmes.d: It's off to the Cretaceous period for the Gadget team as Spydra tries to amass an army of dinosaurs.
Gadget boy, his friends, and chief Strombli are off to stop Spydra’s most evil plan yet!
Inspector Gadget investigates mysterious ghosts in South America that scare off the miners.  As usual, it is the work of Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget is hot on the trail of a famous Dutch diamond in Holland, stolen by Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Brain are off to the Rocky Mountains to rescue a seismologist who M.A.D has captured.
Inspector Gadget foils the evil plans of Dr. Claw to steal a valuable pearl necklace.  This adventure takes Chief Quimby and the Inspector to Hong Kong.
Inspector Gadget foils an M.A.D. plot to kidnap the Shah of Freeland for ransom.
Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Chief Quimby locate and destroy a secret device of M.A.D. that melts metal.
Chief Quimby and Penny aid Inspector Gadget in rescuing three famous oceanographers who are kidnapped by M.A.D
Dr. Focus of M.A.D. invents a machine called Sneezooka which creates the wind of 3 billion sneezes.  Inspector Gadget finds the secret laboratory and destroys the machine.
The beautiful M.A.D. agent Labella is disrupting the peaceful country of Pianostan.  Inspector Gadget stops her before she causes a revolution.
Dr. Claw is kidnapping billionaires and stealing their money. Inspector Gadget rescues the captured billionaires and protects their money.
Zany Inspector Gadget ends up at the M.A.D. Academy for new agents instead of the Police Academy.  With the help of Chief Quimby and Penny, the Inspector is rescued from Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget travels to Malaysia to find the famous explorers that were captured by Dr. Claw.  Chief Quimby, Penny and Brain, infected with a deadly virus, are also captured.
M.A.D. is suspected of stealing the Blarney Stone and is holding it for ransom. With the luck of a four-leaf clover and Penny, Inspector Gadget recovers the Stone.
Inspector Gadget must locate the stolen Seal of Romania, or Dr. Claw will become their King.
The two oldest tribes in the Balkan Mountains are waging battle, endangering the entire area.  M.A.D. is suspected of triggering the war.  Inspector Gadget is on duty to investigate the crime.
Watch Inspector Gadget every weeknight at 7/6c on Pluto TV.  The famous Emerald Duck is stolen from the temple of the Sungod.  Inspector Gadget exposes the criminal and restores order.
Dr. Claw is causing dairy cows to stop giving milk. His diabolical plan is to monopolize the manufacture and sale of dairy products in Metro City.
Inspector Gadget and Penny prevent Daedalus and Dr. Claw from stealing the secret formula of King Croesus of turning lead into gold.
There are undersea explosions near Everest Island in the South Pacific.  M.A.D. agents are suspected to threaten island resorts and demand protection money.
Watch Inspector Gadget every weeknight at 7/6c on Pluto TV.  M.A.D. has reduced a counterfeiter to a very tiny size.  Inspector Gadget must stop them, or they will make millions.
From M.A.D. headquarters to a secret military base, Inspector Gadget and Penny track down jets stolen by Dr. Claw.
M.A.D. has stolen all of Metro City's water and plans to hold it for ransom.  It is up to Inspector Gadget to recover the missing water.
Dr. Stench, an agent of M.A.D., has invented a substance that makes gold smell terrible.  Since smelly gold cannot be kept in bank vaults, it will be valueless in international markets.
Inspector Gadget protects Nick Defecto.  M.A.D. is trying to destroy him because of the secret he knows.
M.A.D. has invented a weather machine that controls the weather and is demanding money from cities.  Inspector Gadget has to find and destroy the machine.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to stop M.A.D. from kidnapping the scientists of the world and holding them for ransom.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to guard a priceless coin collection from the evil clutches of M.A.D.
Millionaires in Paris are being robbed of their jewels and money.  M.A.D. is behind the plot; sending warning notes in advance.
Dr. Claw has invented a spray that rots wood instantly.  If he is not paid one million dollars, he will destroy every forest in the world.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to foil Dr. Claw from stealing the Star of Istanbul.
M.A.D. is threatening to steal the King of Fuzug's treasure. Inspector Gadget's mission is to save the treasure from Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget protects Fang the Wonderdog from M.A.D. who wants to kidnap Fang and make millions in ransom.
Inspector Gadget, Brain, and Penny foil the evil plans of Dr. Claw's henchman from the LeDip School for Pickpockets as they try to steal the Inspector's new watch.

Hoping for more privacy, Richie moves out of the Cunningham home to share an apartment with his brother and soon discovers it's not the paradise he expected.
Richie's fears get the best of him while he's reading a book on abnormal psychology and it drives him to secretly see a psychiatrist.
Hollywood comes to Jefferson High when Richie wins a dance date with a beautiful movie star in a school raffle.
Richie lets fame go to his head when he takes a turn as a disc jockey at the local radio station.

While in Chicago with their high school choir, Richie, Ralph, and Potsie sneak by their chaperons, wind up on the wrong side of an unsympathetic downtown nightclub owner, and win the sympathy of a kind-hearted cocktail waitress.
The Cunningham family plans a quiet, old-fashioned family Christmas until Richie discovers Fonzie faces a lonely holiday.
Laverne and Shirley concoct a scheme to come face-to-face with the killer who has tried to poison Shirley and who has kidnapped Lenny and Squiggy.
Sgt. Alvinia Plout, the girls’ Women’s Army Corps’ nemesis, talks them into participating in an army survival test.
Laverne and Shirley lose their jobs and move to California to realize their dreams of fame and romance.
While seeking to meet film star Troy Donahue, Laverne and Shirley are mistaken for stuntwomen and get involved in some wild scenes.
Shirley discovers that the wife of the about-to-be-divorced man she loves, is her mirror image.
Lenny and Squiggy have Edna talking to herself when they tell her that they’ve developed a radical new style of movies—silent films.
Laverne and Shirley unknowingly eat cookies laced with marijuana at a party and soon find themselves on the verge of marrying two British rock stars.
Laverne and Shirley hilariously try to cover their tracks after entering their supervisor’s office to retrieve a nasty note they’ve written to him.
Squiggy forgets his lines in a play written by Shirley, so Laverne and Shirley cover all the parts while a famed Broadway producer watches from the audience.
Lenny and Squiggy’s attempt to start a talent agency lands Laverne and Shirley on national television with Latvian acrobats.

programmes.st: Putting the Ork Back In Mork (Part 2)
programmes.d: It could be Mork's last night on Earth when an ancient Orkan elder who looks like a ten-year-old boy arrives with the news that Mork must return to Ork for forecycling because he has picked up too many Earthly ways.

With Mindy depressed about not getting a scholarship, it's up to Mork to stir up some laughs, so he brings home a friend who claims to be the real Peter Pan, with the power to fly as just one of his magical talents.

It's the biggest, funniest roller marathon ever when Mork takes to skates for the first time to race a cheating champion skater down a Rocky Mountain peak into Boulder to save the day care center at which he works from destruction.

Spaceman Mork gets so cosmically carried away with pulling practical jokes that he surprises Mindy by assembling her jeep in their living room right over Mr. Bickley's apartment - with disastrous results.
Mork turns the apartment he shares with Mindy into a hilarious hideaway for a young chimpanzee that he kidnaps from the Boulder zoo in the mistaken belief that the animal's mother has been abducted.

Mork sends the face-lifting business into orbit when he hilariously rushes to a plastic surgeon to shoot the works after Mindy gives Mork the idea that everyone could use a little improverrent on Mork & Mindy.

Naive Mork puts on his own out-of-this-world telethon to help Mindy raise charity funds, but is such a funny failure at fund-raising that he turns to his own outrageous brand of panhandling to come up with the needed money.
Mindy, hired by a small TV station, has a disastrous on-camera debut until Mork leaps to a riotous rescue with his far-out Orkan presentation of the evening news.
Richie and Fonzie must think fast to outwit a tough housemother after they're caught past curfew in the college girls' dormitory.
Soon after getting the bad news that the studio deemed his James Dean impression obsolete, and gave Richie's wholesome good looks a contract instead, the Fonz finds a bigger fish to fry.
Richie must choose either a 5-year Hollywood contract or college in Milwaukee while the Fonz accepts the California Kid's challenge to perform a dangerous water ski jump...over a shark!

Forced to spend the night in the hospital's children's ward, Fonzie worries more about who will be making time with his girl at the Halloween party than the tonsillectomy he's scheduled for the next morning.
Fonzie is furious with his rebellious cousin, Chachi Arcola, after Chachi cheats on a school test using answers stolen from a tutoring session with Joanie Cunningham.
To prove to his college journalism professor that he has what it takes to be a good investigative reporter, Richie gets down and dirty to expose who's behind an illegal garbage collection scheme.
Snobby Cynthia Holmes schemes with her obnoxious cousin, Skippy, to make the Fonz look foolish at a country club soirée.
Richie, Ralph, and Potsie endure the harassment of "hell week" to prove themselves worthy to enter their college fraternity, Phi Kappa Nu.

Sophomore Joanie Cunningham gets basic back-seat defense tips from Richie and Fonzie before her first "car date" with a senior boy, and then cramps her older brother's style when she and her date show up at his college "make-out" party.
When Larry and Jennifer set a wedding date, Balki checks their compatibility with the Myposian Marriage Test.
Balki has a simple bachelor party planned for Larry, but Mr. Gorpley changes everything when he arrives.
On their way to the wedding, Larry and Balki are pulled over and arrested after Larry backs into a patrol car.
Larry and Jennifer realize they can't afford the new house they just rented.
Larry and Balki take jobs selling cleaning products door-to-door.
The king of Mypos comes to Chicago for a visit and promptly dies in Larry's arms - making Larry the new king.
Balki and Larry battle a ghost who has taken up residence in their house.
Larry and Balki want to build a gazebo in the backyard, but they're hampered by their complete lack of skill.
Larry has Balki's mother flown in as a surprise for Balki, who is about to be sworn in as a U.S. citizen.
Larry leaves for Mypos to bring Balki back to America, but instead decides he wants to live in Mypos, too.
Larry and Balki believe a lost wedding ring is stuck inside the neighbor's turkey and try to get it back.
When Larry and Balki collaborate on a new cartoon, tensions between the two rise.
Larry and Balki have an alarm put in the car, but it keeps going off all night.
Balki and Larry are chosen for jury duty the day before their non-refundable vacation to Bermuda begins.
When Balki's artistic inspiration is stolen, Balki loses the ability to draw his daily comic strip.
At an auction, Larry mistakenly bids on an expensive bottle of wine.
Jennifer's potential pregnancy prompts Larry to dream about the past and future.
In Las Vegas, Balki desperately wants to see Wayne Newton, so Larry lies to get tickets to the sold-out show.
Larry and Balki must move Wainwright's new couch into his office via the elevator.
A theater group wants to perform Larry's play, but he alienates the entire cast and crew.
Larry and Balki are selected as subjects for a study on psychological stress.
After a misunderstanding, Mary Anne threatens to leave Balki, and Balki believes Jennifer is in love with him.
While Mary Anne and Jennifer are away, Balki and Larry bring home two women from a singles bar.
Balki and Mary Anne fall for look-alikes of each other.

programmes.st: Get Me To The Dump On Time
programmes.d: Balki announces he's getting married tomorrow, but Larry has lost the Myposian marriage necklace.
Balki and Mary Anne bring a herb from Mypos to help Jennifer, but Balki and Larry eat it and become addicted.
Larry and Balki get locked in a department store with a vicious attack dog.
Balki is certain an ancient Myposian curse has befallen him and believes anything he touches will die.
Balki and Larry compete against each other on a quiz show, but Balki learns Larry has been cheating.
After a balloon flight prompts Mary Anne into labor, Jennifer decides to take a ride to get her labor started.
As Larry, Balki, and Jennifer helplessly fly away in a runaway balloon, Jennifer gives birth to her baby.
Two newlyweds move in next door to their married friends.
The friends play "I Never" and unearth some surprising revelations.
Dean's mother visits and drives the couple crazy with criticism.
Bobbi tries reverse psychology on Reggie.

programmes.st: The Gift That Keeps on Giving
programmes.d: Bobbi and Reggie decide to test their commitment.
Malena and Mel get more than they bargained for at a couples seminar.

Col. Hogan and his Heroes assist local resistance forces sabotage hidden explosive stashes the Gestapo plans to use to destroy bridges and other resources as the Nazis prepare to retreat from advancing Allied Forces.
Colonel Hogan and Commandant Klink go to London to steal a plane as part of a plan to ferret out German spies in England.
Efforts to aid a Nazi general's assassination plan hit a snag when Schultz unknowingly activates a time bomb meant for the Führer.
Hogan provides information to a German baroness that includes phony invasion plans.

While trying to free the underground agent "Tiger" in Paris, Hogan must seek help from a Parisian fortune teller and also enlist the aid of a man who is a look-alike for Nazi Police Chief Heinrich Himmler!
Klink nabs a spy, so Hogan takes the focus off his catch by making Klink think someone's trying to kill the commandant himself, leading Klink to have Hogan become a decoy commandant.
The prisoners create an elaborate underground ruse to fool a German spy that has been placed in their ranks.
Hogan plants an empty parachute in the camp sending the Germans on a wild goose chase for a downed Allied agent.
The Allied Command orders Colonel Hogan to leave and turn over his operations to the bumbling Colonel Crittendon.

programmes.st: Clearance Sale at the Black Market
programmes.d: How can Hogan and his crew keep Sgt. Schultz from being transferred to the Russian Front?
The Germans have set up a money-counterfeiting operation in the camp,and Hogan is planning on destroying it.
The Germans are sending Hogan to America demanding surrender along with another surprise.
Bumbling British Colonel Crittendon again disrupts Hogan's plans to get out an Allied officer who is also named Crittendon.
There seems to be a traitor in the escaped prisoner pipeline and Hogan has to find him by following the escape route.

To improve the camp's inspection rating, Klink transfers in a stern German sergeant who quickly makes life miserable for staff and prisoners alike with his overly strict and unwavering adherence to all regulations. All want him gone.
Hogan first saves, then helps to escape, a German radio expert who the Germans want dead.

Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.
Although Ricky is having lunch with Richard Widmark, he refuses to introduce Lucy because she has become a legend around Hollywood for her crazy escapades.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Lucy hates the mustache that Ricky grows for a potential movie role and demands that he shave it off. When he refuses, Lucy gets a fake beard and glues it on her face. To teach Ricky a lesson, she kisses her husband with the beard on when he arrives home.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.

After watching two women walk out of a local dress shop with $200 in purchases, Lucy and Ethel decide to buy the shop and go into business for themselves. The first signs of trouble begin when they can't agree on a name for their store.

Ricky Ricardo's new fame leads to an invitation to appear on a television interview program. The live interview is to take place in their home and Ricky's new agent wants them to move to a more posh apartment.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

With her baby due any moment, Lucy finds it challenging trying to remain calm given Ricky's nervous behavior. When she asks the Mertzes to come over to offset Ricky, she winds up with three very anxious people.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.

Lucy wants to get into the act when Ricky is producing an Indian show at the Tropicana. Ricky instead hires the Mertzes to be part of the show, hoping Lucy will be cured of her show biz bug now that she is a mother.

Ricky's friend Charlie Appleby and his wife Caroline are coming over for dinner at the Ricardos. Charlie is going to have Ricky emcee a TV program he's working on and so Ricky wants to make a good impression at dinner.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

Lucy and Ethel are tired of their dishpan hands and demand dishwashers from their husbands. They also don't think the Society Matrons League, a club they want to join, would approve. Their husbands believe they have it easy compared to the olden days.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky needs a ballet dancer and a burlesque comic for his club's new musical revue. Lucy wants the ballet gig and takes dance lessons from a strict instructor. Learning the disciplined art is much more difficult than she imagined.

Suburbanite Lucy gets a green thumb and a competitive spirit. She has been raising tulips with a vengeance and wants to dethrone her neighbor Betty Ramsey for "Best Looking Garden" in the local garden club competition.

Not feeling well, Lucy takes herself to the doctor and receives the happy news that she is pregnant. Ethel and Fred find out before Ricky and eagerly begin dreaming about being the lucky godparents. Getting the news to Ricky is not as easy.

Little Ricky is turning 5 years old and Lucy had a party planned for Saturday, but Caroline Appleby is throwing a birthday party for her son Stevie on the same day. Neither mother is willing to change the date of their party.

Ricky brings home a $3,500 mink coat to be used in his nightclub act, and Lucy assumes it's her anniversary present. Trying to get the coat away from her becomes a problem because Lucy not only wears it while she does housework, she even sleeps in it.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.

The Ricardos and Mertzes have a close encounter of the French kind when they go to a bistro and have no clue how to read the menu. Later on, Lucy and Ethel decide to brush up on their French in order to get into the show.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

After the Mertzes have a quarrel the Ricardos try their best to get them back together. Lucy invites each of them to dinner without the other knowing. The Mertzes finally reconcile but in the process, the Ricardos squabble.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

The IMF sets out to destroy a murder-for-hire organization.
Casey poses as a young peasant girl from Europe imported to be the bride of Joe Corvin, the top man at getting underworld millions into Swiss banks.

As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Guest star Jack Cassidy is Orin Kerr, an ex-hoodlum who now controls the largest gambling resort in the western hemisphere as a front for the underworld crime syndicate.

Guest star Anne Francis joins the IMF when it sets out to prevent destruction of a secret formula vital to America's missile defense system on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Andrew Duggan guest stars as Justin Bainbridge, a multimillionaire paranoid militarist, whose son, Howard, defected behind the Iron Curtain with the formula to a lethal nerve gas he had developed in "A Ghost Story"
William Windom guest stars as Paul Mitchell, a boxing promoter tied to a crime syndicate who becomes a target of the IMF when one of his fighters is killed before he can talk to the police.
A grave threat to national security is posed when an enemy agent (Albert Paulsen) kidnaps two of the three key scientists who collectively know the formula for the cobalt bomb.
An imprisoned member of the Nazi party, Herbert Raynor, is released from prison and is being flown to Puerto Huberra in South America, along with other Nazis.
Phelps and Mimi take on the guises of fugitives to invade the home of Jerome Cooper, a nuclear scientist, who is threatening to destroy a major American city with a fifty-megaton hydrogen bomb.
Robert Webber guest stars as Charles Rogan, a syndicate leader with the key to the five million dollar bankroll that will finance the overthrow the government of Camagua.
The resurgence of neo-Nazism in Germany takes the IMF to Bavaria, where Marcus von Frank (Hans Gudegast) threatens to become a second Hitler.
A former prison guard, Sefra, has acquired a supply of cesium 138, which explodes at temperatures above 70 degrees.

programmes.st: Drawing a Picture with Closed Eyes
programmes.d: Mister Rogers tries to draw a picture with his eyes closed, but it doesn't turn out well. He visits Crist Delmonico, a blind artist who can visualize his artwork in his mind. King Friday announces that Queen Ida is coming to visit.
Mister Rogers deciphers an invisible ink note from Mr. McFeely and shows a video of how people make suitcases.

Mister Rogers enters wearing a reindeer hat complete with antlers. King Friday declares that everyone in the Neighborhood must wear at hat.   Andy Holiner and Alice Johnson sing  with some young friends.

programmes.st: It's fun when no one is left out
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a Randy S. Caribou figure made of clay. Then, visiting a nearby soccer field, Mister Rogres meets Dave Bartholomae, a coach who is holding practice with his young players.

programmes.st: Visit with a Special Olympics Team
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a basket from a Native American friend who keeps it near his door for friends to "put burdens here and come inside." Bob Dog invites King Friday to join their game, a first such invitation for the king.
Olympic gold medalist Suzie McConnell comes to give Mister Rogers a basketball lesson. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, everyone is welcomed to be part of a team and given team uniforms.
Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely go bowling where they not only have a chance to bowl, but also to see how pins and balls are set up.

programmes.st: Visit to the San Diego Wild Animal Park
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits the San Diego Wild Animal Park where guide Joan Embery shows him giraffes, elephants, tigers and other animals living there.
Mister Rogers visits a film processing plant to learn how people turn an unexposed roll of film into finished photographs.
The Neighborhood of Make-Believe presents "Josephine the Short-Neck Giraffe," a musical story for children by Mister Rogers!

The special 3-part musical story for children continues as Josephine and Hazel Elephant enroll at the School for Growing, where they meet a snake who can't hiss, an elephant with stripes, and a very shy giraffe.
"Josephine the Short-Neck Giraffe" concludes today as shy J. R. Giraffe helps Josephine learn to accept herself just the way she is.
Mister Rogers helps out at Negri's Nusic Shop when Helena leaves to care for her sick son. Queen Sara learns that an employee of "Food for the World" is sick and her help is needed.
Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely show how they make an apple-peanut butter treat and remind children how much they learn from people other than their parents.
Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make peanut butter. Lady Aberlin agrees to take care of Daphne. Henrietta Pussycat suggests making a daycare center at the factory, and Corney agrees.

Mister Rogers meets Natasha, a famous oboeist. She shows pictures of her children and says she expresses her feelings for them through her music. Prince Tuesday is considering getting sick so that his parents will stay home from work.

Marilyn Barnett invites Mister Rogers outside for some exercises.  Bruce Franco carries a collection of balloon scuptures he has made for the party. He gives Mister Rogers a balloon sculpture that looks like the Neighborhood Trolley.

Mister Rogers introduces a week of programs about the environment. He shows how things can be reused. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, there's a real-life problem -- too much garbage -- and the neighbors are trying to find a solution.

Mister Rogers arrives with a bandage on his left hand. He pulls back the bandage to show that his hand is still there. Ana scraped her paw but does not want a bandage. Lady Aberlin is able to convince her otherwise.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make adhesive bandages. Prince Tuesday is looking for someone to play with but all of his friends are busy. At the suggestion of King Friday, he pretends that his rag doll has come to life.

Mister Rogers shows a video of wolves "singing," and wolf expert Kent Weber stops by with two wolves and explains that wolves are shy, not big and bad like in the fairy tales, and how they live together in families.
Folksinger Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers with her ukulele and shares songs her father enjoyed.
Yo-Yo Ma describes how he misses his family when he is gone and plays Bach's Sarabande on his cello. Sitting at the piano, Yo-Yo's son Nicholas plays the Skater's Waltz as a duet with his father.

Mister Rogers goes to Brockett's Bakery to decorate gingerbread men. After hearing the sound effect from the laughing box, Lady Aberlin sees how long neighbors take to laugh. Eric Kloss makes different sounds using a wind synthesizer.
Mister Rogers plays with different-sized cardboard tubes. Lady Aberlin is observing how neighbors react to the laughter box. Dr. Maggie Kimmel tells the story of “Button Broth.”

Mister Rogers shows a video of how people make toothbrushes. Lady Aberlin observes the neighbors' reactions after she can turn herself into a tiger. Princess Zelda arrives in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Learning to Take Care of Yourself
programmes.d: Mister Rogers brushes his teeth in his bathroom talks about how important it is to take care of our teeth, and even visits a dentist's office!

Mister Rogers shows a film of an earthmover digging a hole. Mr. McFeely shows a toothpaste video. Lady Aberlin wears a tiger suit, so she can be related to Daniel. Daniel declares that they are related by their hearts.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Has a Model Car
programmes.d: At the request of a television neighbor, Mister Rogers arrives with a model car and uses wooden blocks to build a roadway for it to travel. Prince Tuesday does not understand why he is not big like Neighbor Aber and King Friday.

Paper-thin holographic televisions, seawater-powered cars, robotic armies, space luxury resorts and mind-controlled cleaning droids represent future technology; explore realistic predictions through 3D animation and working prototypes.

Hoping to score big on the East Coast, Mike and Frank make stops in Virginia, DC, and Maryland, and are delirious when they find themselves waist-deep in a treasure-packed machine shop. Harry's property is wired for maximum security.

While cruising the back roads of North Carolina, the guys get a somewhat vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes. The XAVW is a legendary masterpiece because of its detailing and unique components. Mike is determined to find it.
Tricky Dick's Tennessee yard is littered with treasures, and though he isn't motivated to part with any of it, Mike goes hog-wild for a vintage pig ride that could be worth some serious coin.
Mike and Frank head to Ohio and decide to make the trip a little more interesting by bringing along a cup dispenser from an old train station to trade with their clients, hoping to make some cash.

In an offbeat episode, the team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years before. Their different stories remind us how they used to work alone... and why we’re so glad they now work together.

The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead. Also, Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

As the team hunts a killer who is shooting seemingly unrelated targets, an experience on the job has a new agent Tiffany, examining the tension between her career as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.
After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team passes a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion.

Tina finds out about Candace; Shane’s patrons turn on her; Dana loses a friend but gains a fiancée, while Kit tries to make sense of Ivan’s attention and her reaction to it.

The second season opens as rumors circulate about Marina’s suicide attempt and her return home to Italy.  This news has a devastating effect on Jenny even as she prepares for an emotional goodbye with Tim who has accepted a coaching job in Ohio.

Tina hires gay-rights lawyer Joyce Wischnia to represent her in the division of assets with Bette. Kit tracks down Ivan at her cabin in the country and proposes a business partnership that Ivan agrees to consider.

Jenny is instantly smitten when she meets her new roommate, Shane’s current love interest, Carmen.  Carmen is both dejected and intrigued by Shane’s inability to open up, but is also attracted to Jenny.

Bette travels to New York for some damage control with Helena Peabody, the new administrator of a foundation that provides financial support to the Art Center. Shane and Jenny interview prospective roommates but can’t quite find the perfect candidate.
Jenny and Shane's new roommate secretly tapes them.
Tina moves out; Alice gives Dana an ultimatum.
Alice and Dana tentatively begin dating, while Tina comes between Helena and her ex. Bette rejoins the singles scene, and Shane dulls her pain over Jenny and Carmen.
Bette and Tina agree to forge a new relationship. Jenny loses a chance to ghost-write a macho TV star's autobiography because she's gay.
Alice's sex-toy request freaks out Dana. Jenny learns the truth about TV star Burr, and about Carmen's feelings for Shane.
A lesbian cruise in the Caribbean proves eventful for Dana, Alice, Shane, Jenny and Carmen, while Bette and Kit struggle to connect with their aging father Melvin during a visit.

Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature.  Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back.  After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller.  After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.
The "universal soldiers" must fight the whole army, when the military's supercomputer S.E.T.H gets out of control.

ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller.  After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

Scott Sibella, President and COO of the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, goes undercover within the walls of the second-largest hotel in the world and faces a group of rowdy gamblers who are quick to point out his shortcomings as a dealer.

Bill Massa, President and CEO of Synagro, the nation's largest waste water treatment corporation, goes undercover in the series' dirtiest mission to date and finds himself cleaning a tank of 27-year-old sludge.
It's Boston's annual Battle of the Burger competition and Donnie is putting pressure on Paul to grill up a win.

The Wahlbergs head to Toronto for the grand opening of the new Wahlburgers. Paul is stressed, as usual, so Donnie heads to Canada to help his brother out, with his wife Jenny and son Elijah by his side.

Paul takes a trip with his kids to visit Mark, Rhea and the kids in Los Angeles. A simple family BBQ turns into a battle of Wahlberg clans during a game of touch football. Mark utilizes his home field advantage to torment Paul.
As part of the ever expanding Wahlberg empire, Mark searches for new ventures. But when members of his entourage attempt to pitch their own ideas, tempers flare and Mark is caught in the middle.

Mark pledges to make a Super Bowl Burger to the New England Patriots' owner, Robert Kraft. Paul is excited to honor his hometown team until pals Rob Gronkowski and Julien Edelman request a Boston clam themed burger instead.
As two of the busiest brothers in show business, Mark and Donnie are rarely in the same city at the same time.
The premiere of the Entourage movie gives the real life entourage an opportunity to meet their fictional alter egos.

With the restaurant open in Toronto, Paul must decide on Wahlburger's poutine--a Canadian dish made of French fries, cheese curds, and gravy. The NKOTB tour puts Donnie in town to help. In Los Angeles, Mark receives a visit from his older brother, Bob.
Jeff has one day to clear out a Chinese grocery store full of exotic and vile stock.
Jeff makes an impulse buy. Meanwhile, Daniel ends up with a truckload of shoes that are all the same size.
Jeff takes a gamble in trying to sell some broken pianos, an assortment of pickled peppers, and a collection of ornamental seashells.
Jeff spends thousands on a military warehouse package deal that includes a decommissioned .50 caliber machine gun.
Customer satisfaction isn't always guaranteed in this top ten episode of Customer Wars, especially if there are fists involved.
A woman vandalizes a New Jersey convenience store by randomly sweeping items off the shelves. A rideshare driver in Florida is pushed to the brink by a rude and unsanitary rider.
Customers brawl over an all you can eat crab legs buffet in Queens, NY. Trash talking between two groups of diners at a pancake house in Texas comes to blows.
A man in Florida attacks a fast food cashier apparently over a lack of available straws. A grounded passenger in Texas gets a serious comeuppance after slapping an airline employee.

Supermarket loss prevention officers try to wrangle an accused teenage shoplifter. The owner of a watch shop fights off two masked robbers. A woman attempting to buy alcohol at a pharmacy refuses to show her identification.
A delivery driver falls through a plate glass window at a New York pizza parlor. A concert goer in Toronto is accused of throwing a glass container at the stage and is set upon by the band.
Dave Rife, White Castle owner and grandson of the founder, goes undercover in the family business.
COO of Churchill Downs, Bill Carstanjan, faces his fear of horses head-on to go undercover in his own company.
Michael Rubin, one of America's youngest CEOs, goes undercover in the billion-dollar e-commerce company that he founded.

Buying partnerships are tested at an auction in Brampton. Bogart puts Paul on a diet. Meanwhile, Rick squirms when Cindy wants him to wear a spiffy new shirt. Ursula tries on her bossy-pants, but what Roy finds really puts the icing on the cake.

programmes.st: Keep Your Friends Close And The Veterans Closer
programmes.d: Paul and Bogart declare storage war on the veterans at an auction in Orillia. Roy bums a ride off them instead. Ursula has a bad hair day, and Rick and Cindy meet former Stanley Cup Champion Nick Kypreos.

Roy is up to his usual antics at an auction in the Old Weston neighborhood of Toronto but this time Ursula strikes back. Paul and Bogart are the epitome of the blind leading the blind, while Rick and Cindy's locker is more than meets the eye.

Paul and Bogart concoct an entirely new strategy for an auction in Leaside: to have no strategy at all. Rick and Cindy play doctor, Ursula gets her geek on, and Roy rocks out with Canadian metal icon Robb Reiner.

Ursula hopes her pet chinchilla will bring her luck at an auction in East Gwillimbury, but little Monty has ideas of his own. Rick and Cindy get into watersports, Paul and Bogart make a virtue of chastity, and Roy comes to work in his pajamas.

A soldier infiltrates a high-tech facility, convinced his missing wife is trapped inside. What he finds is a seductive, futuristic fantasy park where reality and illusion blur, drawing him into a deadly game where nothing is as it seems.

programmes.t: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programmes.d: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

A soldier infiltrates a high-tech facility, convinced his missing wife is trapped inside. What he finds is a seductive, futuristic fantasy park where reality and illusion blur, drawing him into a deadly game where nothing is as it seems.
Captain Orion battles an army of bloodthirsty Orcs and legions of ravenous creatures as he guards a mysterious messenger carrying a secret that will alter the fate of all mankind.
In the Old Stone Age, a disparate gang of early humans band together in search of a new land.
A small-town rabbi becomes an unlikely detective and gunfighter after his community is violently attacked in this sharp, high-stakes thriller packed with action, wit, and heart.

An ex-CIA operative turned painter is thrown into danger when a woman from his past resurfaces. Now targeted by a relentless killer and a rogue black ops program, he must rely on skills he thought he left behind in a high-stakes game of survival.

When a popular high school basketball star gets dumped by his girlfriend, he desperately does anything to get her back. With the help of his best friend's sister, he joins the same school musical as his ex... resulting in an inevitable love triangle.
Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programmes.d: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.
Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

After 20 years of grooming, Cosimo de' Medici replaces his late father in the Signoria of Florence.

programmes.st: The Death Song of Uther Pendragon
programmes.d: When a stranger gives Arthur the power to summon the dead, the king finds himself torn between head and heart.
With Princess Mithian as the perfect bait, Morgana conjures a deception.
In the inky depths of an ancient pool, three soothsayers cast a dark judgment upon the king of Camelot.
When Gwen is snatched from Camelot without warning, Merlin knows there can be only one person responsible.
Darkness steals into the very heart of Camelot as Morgana and her puppet queen hatch a sinister plan.
When Merlin agrees to help a young Druid boy, he has no choice but to leave Camelot on a dangerous mission.
Merlin knows he must act fast before Morgana's twisted control over Gwen gets further out of hand.
Morgana leads a terrifying pursuit of her old foe, Alator of the Catha.
Mordred finds himself torn between loyalty and love, that the path he chooses will shape Camelot's destiny.

programmes.st: The Diamond of the Day: Part 1
programmes.d: High in the mountains, Morgana prepares for war with a vengeful Mordred at her side.

programmes.st: A Bride. A Box. A Body.
programmes.d: Mary pursues her quest for justice as she launches a counter attack on her conspirators. Elizabeth suffers a major setback that turns her world upside down.

Childbirth threatens to take Mary's life, which leaves her and her unborn child's safety in jeopardy. Elizabeth discovers that someone in her inner circle was the cause of the death of someone close to her.
Mary makes a decision that will change the course of history. Mary's perilous move for her survival causes the stunning realization that perhaps she is not the only one who may not survive.

After spending a childhood safely hidden away in a monastery, a teenage Mary Stuart arrives in France where she has been sent to secure Scotland's strategic alliance by formalizing her arranged engagement to the French King's dashing son.
When Simon, an English envoy, tells Mary that the English are aware of her fragile engagement to Francis, Mary and Francis put on a show to protect their alliance.

When England's armies threaten Scotland's borders, Mary asks King Henry for help. Tomas, the son of the King of Portugal, proposes marriage to Mary, promising her aid against England if she'll abandon Francis and turn to Tomas instead.
Each member of the group goes through a near-death experience while being attacked by bounty hunters.
A shadowy case casts light on Agent Broyles' past and leads the team to the possibility of foreign Fringe Science — as alarming events mount and details emerge about Broyles.
A disconcerting kidnapping rapidly escalates into a hostage situation in New York, as the Fringe Division discovers a mysterious force with mind-blowing consequences.
There's more than one Observer! When one of the series' mysterious Observers kidnaps a woman, the Fringe team is called in to investigate why.
After a cargo ship runs aground, the Fringe team investigates a mysterious parasitic organism when the shoreline becomes littered with bodies hosting a giant squid-like creature.
Dr. Walter Bishop's braininess takes on a new meaning when the Fringe team investigate impromptu brain surgeries — and William Bell (LEONARD NIMOY) resurfaces.
A resurrected girl with unexpected ties to a missing soldier requires some fringe intervention in a special unearthed episode from the first season.
Following an unexplained attack, the Fringe team visits a small town where a population of disfigured humans have hidden themselves — and they'll do anything to keep it that way.
The group finally tracks down Murphy. During a mission to transport survivors to safety, blasters attack.
The group makes its way to the greenhouse where Batch 47 is being grown by Odegard.
Murphy's past comes back to haunt him when Serena tracks him down. The team stumbles upon a hidden farm.
Murphy separates from the group out of fear that they may take the baby away— and kill her.
Investigating a lethal virus, Peter & Olivia become isolated inside a quarantined building and face life-threatening circumstances — while the rest of the team tries to save them.
Investigating a lethal toxin that was unleashed on a wedding ceremony as a weaponized experiment, Walter uncovers an alarming formula that reveals a link to the Bishop family tree.
When a violent tremor shakes a Manhattan office building and only one survivor is found, Walter surmises that its cause is rooted in his research with William Bell many years ago.
While explaining Peter's otherworldly origins to Olivia, Walter flashes back to 1985 where Peter's mother (guest star ORLA BRADY) is introduced.

programmes.st: Olivia. In the Lab. With the Revolver.
programmes.d: When a healthy woman is found dead from a disease she never had, the Fringe team investigates the origin of this inexplicably fatal condition before it claims more lives.
There are so many unanswered questions about the stars, the galaxies and the universe and just mapping what lies in the night sky is immensely difficult.
As our expertise in space technology increases there have been spin-offs in many areas: particularly in communications.
The most important planet in the solar system is our home, the Earth. It is the only planet we know that harbours life.
Space technologies are continuing to be refined and access to space is becoming cheaper.
Humans have always used their best technology to save lives.
Green technology is radically changing the way people get around.
High tech is bringing fossils, artwork and historical artifacts to classrooms around the world.
Inventors are up to some crazy things.
Chuck Pell visits a lab where vaccines are developed inside of plants and then processed into pills.
We have always been interested in the workings of Earth, and high tech is giving them new insights.
This lab creates a blistering desert one minute and a tropical rain forest the next.
We now know how many trees are on Earth and, almost in real-time, can tell who’s cutting them down.
The 1960s is a decade of both cultural and technological change.  Home entertainment goes from the kitchen table to the TV screen when the video game console is unveiled.
The cell phone moves from the car console to the hand when an engineer is inspired by a science fiction series.  The hybrid car is reborn as an answer to the concerns over fossil fuels.
The 1980s launch an unprecedented technological age that will continue into the next century. DNA profiling begins changing crime scene investigations for all time.

A new telescope named Hubble lets us see even further into the universe, revealing more of its majesty and mysteries.  A young software engineer's wife gives birth to his daughter while he develops the camera phone in the waiting room.
Throughout history, ancestors have always strived to go higher, bigger, deeper, further.
Exploring some of history's most ingenious, yet lesser-known engineering solutions.
Building structures and machines to harness water.
Migration, travel and trade are all key components of human life.

The earth is 4.5 billion years old and it is slowly dying. Tectonic activity is slowly cooling the planet – the continents will eventually move together to form a new supercontinent called Pangea Ultima.

Earth has an evil twin. Venus. It is shrouded in a lethal atmosphere of carbon dioxide and acid rain. The surface temperature is hot enough to melt lead and the pressure high enough to crush a nuclear submarine.
Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.
In Kevin Smith's most personal film to date, a teenage cinephile tries to woo the girl of his dreams while dealing with a hilarious mix of friends and enemies at his local cinema.
A pioneer of the culture joins forces with a few of rap music's elite performers to attempt to save hip hop.

Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback, Dan Marino. He goes eye-to-eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins, and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.
Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programmes.t: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programmes.d: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!
Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

Four teenagers in detention discover an old video game console with a game they’ve never heard of.  When they decide to play, they are immediately sucked into the jungle world of Jumanji in the bodies of their avatars.
After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

Graduate student and his girlfriend set out on a cross-country roadtrip to research a book they are writing on serial killers. Along the way, they pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend who will take them on a ride they'll never forget.

Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.
A man searches for his missing wife after his car breaks down in the middle of the desert.
When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

A man searches for his missing wife after his car breaks down in the middle of the desert.

A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

"The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.
When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.
When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

Following a failed Exorcism Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver.  Soon Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that the body may be possessed by a demon.
Five friends have found the mysterious and fiercely powerful Book of the Dead, which releases a violent demon on a bloodthirsty quest to possess them all.
Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.
Roman Polanski directs and Johnny Depp stars in this supernatural thriller about a rare-book dealer who discovers a demonic manuscript.
Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.
When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.
Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.
If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?
Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.
A family man is found shot to death and dumped in a rural orchard; it looks like a carjacking.
Jennifer Cave's body is found by her stepfather in an Austin, Texas condo. What follows is a manhunt that leads authorities across the Mexican border to find the truth.
An unsolved shooting in 2003 is linked to two similar murders, a decade later. Ballistics evidence links all three to an unusual bullet type - and even more unusual murder weapons.
Randy Stone is the sort of big-hearted, outgoing guy everybody likes. So how did he end up shot to death on the floor of his Independence, Missouri insurance office?
Wholesome wife and mother Susan Fassett is gunned down outside of her church as she leaves choir practice. Her police lieutenant husband's car is ID'd fleeing the scene.
Pamela Hutchinson travels to Florida to attend a friend's funeral, but after extending her stay, she's found dead in her condo's bathroom.
Just weeks before Christmas, in the sleepy town of Early, Iowa, two men break into the home of Tracey Richter and attack her while her children hide in a nearby bedroom.
Police in Chicago, Illinois connect a series of local murders that ends up putting them on the hunt for a serial killer.
When an affair with a mutual friend turns into a messy divorce and re-marriage, the treachery is just beginning as police try to discover who pulled the trigger on Helium Road.
A wife calls 911 to report a burglary and her husband being shot, but the evidence around the house starts to tell a story of its own.
When a man's family and coworkers lose touch with him for days, the police are sent to his apartment. But what they find is far worse than any of them expected.

High school sweethearts, reunited after 30 years, celebrate their birthdays by taking a cruise together. After a night of drinking during an excursion, one of them ends up beaten and strangled to death. Was an alcohol-soaked scorpion to blame?

When newlyweds are prevented from disembarking on a daytrip due to suspected passport forgery, their relationship begins to unravel. Bigamy leads to bloodshed. And who will be the victims when a handgun is smuggled on board?

The Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia are rocked by a massive pipe bomb explosion. Police have no clue who is behind the bombings until they receive a letter signed by "The Army of God," an anti-abortion, anti-gay, white supremacist group.
A serial rapist stalks and preys on elderly women. Only a revolution in forensic science can strike fear into the heart of this predator.

A self-appointed angel of death on a mission beyond the law disappears into the shadowy underground that supports and protects him. But when the sniper’s mission moves to murder, a city is thrown into a blind panic that spreads across the country.

When New Mexico police discover a broken window at a local head shop called The Eclectic, they expect to find evidence of a robbery. Instead, they uncover a horrific crime scene with two badly mutilated bodies.
Danilo Restivo murdered two women nine years apart: sixteen-year-old Elisa Clapps in Italy and Heather Barnett in Bournemouth.
In and around Gdansk, Poland from 1975 to 1983, Pawell Tuchlin attacked twenty women with a hammer. He brutally killed nine and sexually assaulted them all.

By the age of nineteen, Polish schoolboy Karol Kot, aka the Vampire of Krokow, had killed two people. He tried to kill many more in arson and poison attempts and was executed at the age of twenty-one.
Diane Downs shot her three children, killing her seven-year-old daughter Cheryl and wounding her other two children.
A businessman travels West to join his fiancée in the mountains.
From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.
Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.
The story of the life and work of the Canadian fur trapper-turned-conservationist who claimed to be an aboriginal North American.

There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.
A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.
